name: Roasted Salmon with Garlic Sautéed Leeks

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the centre.
Pat salmon dry with a paper towel and place, skin-side down, on a baking sheet. Rub with olive oil, drizzle with lemon juice, and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash leeks and trim ends. Slice on the diagonal into ¼ inch thick pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Place salmon in the oven and roast until it's opaque, 10-15 minutes (depending on thickness).

Melt butter in oil. Add garlic and stir until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add leeks and season with thyme, salt, and freshly ground pepper; stir to coat in the oil. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks are tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp virgin coconut oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve salmon with buttered leeks on the side. Drizzle with juice from remaining lemon and enjoy!
